00042 // A new UGen also needs a UGenInternal which does the actual processing. 
00043 // UGen and its subclasses are primarily for constructing the UGen graphs.
00044 // Simle internals should inherit from UGenInternal.
00045 class MaximaUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00046 {
00047 public:
00048     // Constructor.
00049     MaximaUGenInternal(UGen const& input) throw();
00050     
00051     // This is called when the internal is needed to process a new block of samples.
00052     void processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw();
00053     
00054     enum Inputs { Input, NumInputs }; // used mainly by the 'inputs' array for the UGenInternal's UGen inputs
00055     
00056 protected:
00057     bool didIncreaseLastTime;
00058     float lastValue;
00059 };
00060 
00061 // A mocro for declaring a UGen subclass.
00062 // The parentheses around the 2nd and 3rd arguments are required.
00063 // Items within these parentheses should be comma-separated just as for argument declarations and calls.
00064 UGenSublcassDeclarationNoDefault
00065 (
00066     Maxima,                 // The UGen name, this will inherit from UGen
00067     (input),                // argument list for the Constructor, AR and KR methods as they would be CALLED
00068     (UGen const& input),    // argument list for the Constructor, AR and KR methods as they are to be DECLARED
00069     COMMON_UGEN_DOCS        // Documentation (for Doxygen)
00070 );
00071 
00072 #if defined(UGEN_USER_MODE) && defined(UGEN_SCSTYLE)
00073 #define Maxima Maxima()
00074 #endif
